source: BNBC 2020 Part 6: the openings and sleeves MEP cuts through beams, slabs and walls; p = PDF page of bnbc-2020-part1.pdf. The slab strip shares are slabMethods.openings, the wall layers concrete.walls.

sources.columnStripShare: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 6.5.2.1 (p. 945): 0.25 l1 or 0.25 l2 each side of the column centreline, whichever is less
sources.punchingDistance: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 6.4.10.6 (p. 942): openings nearer than 10 times the slab thickness to a concentrated load or reaction area, or in a column strip of a flat slab
sources.trimBar: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 6.6.3.7 (p. 969): not less than two 16 mm bars in walls with two layers, one in walls with a single layer, around window, door and similar openings
sources.clauses: As the checks cite them (the short form the reports always printed)
